[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] piloted a '''[[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Luminara flew her Delta-7B during the waning years of the Clone Wars. It was painted with gray and green markings.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
WizKids, Inc., before its operations were discontinued by The Topps Company, Inc., provided a sneak peek at Luminara's Delta-7B as a game piece in an [[Clone Wars Tactics|expansion]] of the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG|''Star Wars PocketModel TCG (Trading Card Game)'']].
